requirement.value: Fencer, Floralist or Archivist (Loremaster) mastery + Virtuose Stance

system.description: Spend 1 Tempo for +2 on a Study or Objective Check; gain 2 Tempo when you enter Virtuose Stance; spend 3 Tempo to advance a Growth Clock one extra time. Objective actions fill Pressure Clocks, so this makes the Fencer a second pressure enabler alongside the Antiquarian. The Growth Clock clause only matters if the character is also a Floralist — and it is the only cross-class lever on that clock in the lineup.
